description: Defines the NetworkIsolationKey class used for isolating shared network resources based on request context, including constructors, comparison operators, serialization methods, and accessors for top frame site, frame site, cross-site indicator, and nonce.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey
classes.description: Represents a key for isolating network resources, supporting different modes (triple-key or 2.5-key), with methods for comparison, serialization, and accessors for internal data.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::SerializationPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class used for serialization-related access control.

classes.name: NetworkIsolationKey::CookiePartitionKeyPasskey
classes.description: Passkey class used for CookiePartitionKey-related access control.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient, non-persisted NetworkIsolationKey with an opaque origin.

methods.name: CreateWithNewFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a new NetworkIsolationKey with a different frame site.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Temporary method to create a NetworkIsolationKey using the same origin for top frame and frame, for legacy or testing purposes.

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode (kFrameSiteEnabled or kCrossSiteFlagEnabled) of the NetworkIsolationKey.
